label: Xiaomi 14 Ultra smartphone
description: Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 Leica flagship. Cellular is 5G NR sub-6 - n1/n2/n3/n5/n7/n8/n20/n28/n38/n40/n41/n48/n66/n77/n78/n79 - with 4x4 MIMO and no mmWave bands listed. Wi-Fi is 7 'capability' per Xiaomi (Wi-Fi 7 needs a Wi-Fi 7 router and is region-dependent). Radios: one wlan (Wi-Fi 7) and one wwan (5G sub-6); the port is USB-C, so there is no RJ45.
notes: Xiaomi words it 'Wi-Fi 7 capability' with a footnote tying it to a Wi-Fi 7 router - that is a vendor claim, not a guaranteed 320 MHz rate, so treat peak PHY as SKU and region dependent. Dual nano-SIM (no eSIM on the global sheet). No Ethernet: a 219 g camera phone with no RJ45, which is the point.
